title: Join us for the June 11th, 2026 Knowledge Portal Network Webinar!
summary: Want an exclusive look at the Knowledge Portal Network June 2026 Production Release?
bodyHtml:
📣 Want an exclusive look at the Knowledge Portal Network June 2026 Production Release?

 

Join us for our Knowledge Portal Webinar as we showcase the latest updates, including a first look at our new Cell State & Program Explorer, designed to help researchers connect genetic discoveries to cellular states, programs, and biological mechanisms.

 

📆 June 11, 2026

⏰ 12:00–1:00 PM ET

 

During this session, we'll highlight:

-New features and enhancements from the June 2026 Production Release

-The new Cell State & Program Explorer, powered by LIGER

-Upcoming events and opportunities to meet with the KPN team

 

💻 Register for the event: https://broadinstitute.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN__dgDoIUZSVyPwKvZ3Xx7mQ
